from pathlib import Path
from datetime import date
import json, math, sys
site = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(site))
import torch
import quantlibtorch as qlt
assert Path(qlt.__file__).is_relative_to(site), qlt.__file__
torch.set_num_threads(1)
vol = torch.tensor(.2, dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
spot = torch.tensor(100., dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
price = qlt.analytic_european(vol, spot=spot)
delta, vega = torch.autograd.grad(price, (spot, vol))
assert abs(price.item()-8.827321225352) < 1e-10
assert delta.isfinite() and vega.isfinite()
fd_price = qlt.fd_vanilla(vol, time_steps=5, grid_points=11)
fd_vega, = torch.autograd.grad(fd_price, (vol,))
assert fd_price.isfinite() and fd_vega.isfinite()
axes = [torch.linspace(math.log(50.), math.log(170.), 9).tolist(), [.01,.03,.05,.09]]
n = 36
drift = torch.zeros((1,1,n,1), dtype=torch.float64)
load = torch.tensor([[.2,0.],[0.,.01]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
factor = load.expand(1,1,n,2,2)
initial = torch.tensor([[math.log(100.), .04]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
plan = qlt.MultiAssetBatch([dict(strikes=[95.,105.], option_types=['put','put'])], axes=axes,
    time_steps=3, exercise='american', cash_dividends=[(date(2025,7,1),1.)])
prices = plan.price(drift, factor, initial, mode='adjoint')
loading_grad, initial_grad = torch.autograd.grad(prices.sum(), (load, initial))
assert torch.isfinite(prices).all() and torch.isfinite(loading_grad).all() and torch.isfinite(initial_grad).all()
print(json.dumps(dict(imported_package=str(qlt.__file__), torch_version=str(torch.__version__),
    analytic_price=price.item(), delta=delta.item(), vega=vega.item(),
    fd_price=fd_price.item(), fd_vega=fd_vega.item(),
    american_dividend_batch_prices=prices.tolist(),
    american_dividend_batch_initial_gradient=initial_grad.tolist(),
    american_dividend_batch_loading_gradient=loading_grad.tolist())))
